source.stimulus: 10 or 12 equal-amplitude components, 60 dB SPL per component, f0 in {100,200,400} Hz, 410 ms, adaptive to d'=1, harmonics 1-6
source.scope_sentence: provided a partial is resolvable, it is heard as separate when it is rejected by a harmonic sieve whose mesh size is a constant percentage of the harmonic frequency
source.companion: Moore, Peters & Glasberg, JASA 77, 1985, 1861-1867 (inharmonicity detection, ~4 Hz at 410 ms)
source.verified: full text fetched and extracted 2026-09-08; Table I and the stimulus line transcribed from the fetched text

what_this_does_not_anchor: the harmonic-sieve stage: this criterion contains no template and cannot produce the 1-3% mistuning thresholds. Anchoring that stage needs a different instrument.

instrument.model: Stage A masking criterion on a harmonic complex

params.name: sigma_scale
params.why: the ERB-matched Gaussian, sigma = ERB/sqrt(2pi): the ERB of a peak-1 Gaussian is its integral, sigma*sqrt(2pi). This is the operating point the operator chose on 2026-09-07 (follow the literature), so the anchor tests the criterion as it is actually used, not a tuned variant

params.name: margin_db
params.why: the primary margin throughout the arc; masked_horizon showed the count is stable across a 12 dB swing at this index

params.name: f0_hz
params.why: the three fundamentals of the norms' own design; resolvability depends on f0 through ERB growth, so a single f0 would not distinguish a calibration from a coincidence

params.name: n_components
params.why: 12 is the norms' stimulus and is REPORTED as such; 60 is the extension needed for a crossover to exist at all, since the pre-registered expectation is a crossover above 12

params.name: resolvability_standard
params.why: DECLARED, not cited: a harmonic is resolved when the auditory filter at its frequency is narrower than the spacing. Arithmetic shown in the report; lands at n_std = 8 for f0 = 200, inside the 8-10 range this literature commonly quotes

params.name: equal_amplitude
params.why: the norms' stimulus is equal-amplitude components (60 dB SPL each); using anything else would not be their stimulus
